purpose: Test a small fixed family of replacement probability architectures using only already exposed non-protected historical evidence, with meeting-held-out evaluation so candidate selection rewards cross-meeting stability rather than same-meeting fit. The frozen B1a confirmatory lineage remains unchanged and is the required baseline.

development_sources.note: One frozen result-fetch failure remains unlabelled and is retained in the manifest but excluded from supervised fitting with explicit reason.

features.numeric_transform: within-race population z-score independently for each numeric feature; zero-variance feature maps to zeros
features.reason_for_forbidden_context_features: The first replacement search tests whether more stable weighting/regularization of the same PRE rider information can generalize across meetings without encoding meeting/venue repair rules already falsified as stable.

fixed_candidate_family.definition: Exact B1a_RECONSTITUTED_v1 probability semantics; blob 62ae4ebc17cda47dca1fffae190fa44caae58ca3; temperature 1.15; no fitting.

fixed_candidate_family.categorical_coding: full fixed one-hot levels with L2 regularization; common additive constant is harmless under within-race softmax

fit_definition.loss: mean race-level multiclass negative log likelihood plus l2_lambda * mean squared coefficient / 2
fit_definition.probability: within-race softmax over entrant linear scores
fit_definition.optimizer: deterministic scipy.optimize L-BFGS-B from all-zero coefficients

evaluation.method: leave-one-meeting-out cross-validation over all 11 labelled development meetings
evaluation.fold_rule: For each meeting, fit only on labelled races from the other 10 meetings and score every labelled race in the held-out meeting.
evaluation.primary_metric: pooled held-out multiclass log loss across all 320 labelled races
secondary_metrics: number of meetings with lower log loss than frozen B1a on the same held-out meeting

candidate_eligibility_and_selection.baseline: BASELINE_B1A_FROZEN evaluated on the exact same 320 development races and 11 meeting groups
eligibility_rules: Candidate pooled held-out log loss must improve on baseline by at least 0.015 absolute.
Candidate must have lower held-out log loss than baseline in at least 6 of 11 meetings.
Candidate pooled held-out winner Top3 rate must not be more than 0.02 below baseline.
candidate_eligibility_and_selection.winner_rule: Among eligible replacement candidates, choose the lowest pooled held-out log loss; tie within 1e-12 is broken by more meetings improved versus baseline, then higher Top1 accuracy, then lexical candidate id.
candidate_eligibility_and_selection.no_eligible_candidate_rule: If no replacement candidate is eligible, record DEVELOPMENT_SEARCH_FAIL_NO_ELIGIBLE_REPLACEMENT and do not open fresh validation outcomes for these candidates. A new preregistered development lineage is required.

post_selection_rule.fit_final_candidate: Only after the cross-validation winner is determined, refit that exact architecture on all 320 labelled development races with the same fixed L2 and feature definition.
post_selection_rule.fresh_validation: A separately preregistered meeting-disjoint historical universe not used in candidate selection must be prediction-frozen under both the selected new candidate and frozen B1a before dedicated target result scoring.
